rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides AI assistants with comprehensive Apache Airflow management capabilities through Bearer token authentication, built by Nikhil Ganage as a fork of Gyeongmo Yang's original implementation with enhanced token-based security support. The implementation exposes the full Airflow REST API including DAG operations (listing, triggering, pausing), task instance management, connection handling, variable management, dataset operations, and monitoring functions, with optional read-only mode for safe querying and automatic UI link generation for enhanced workflow visibility. Serves data engineers needing AI-powered Airflow administration, teams requiring programmatic DAG management through conversational interfaces, and organizations wanting to integrate Airflow operations into their AI workflows with secure token-based authentication for cloud deployments like Astronomer.
